item.title: SAE Aero Design Team
item.description:
Structures engineer on the Texas A&M SAE Aero Design Regular Class team since May 2025. I owned the nose structure: a topology-optimized balsa truss that carried the motors and nose gear through a full season with zero structural failures. Since September 2026 I’m Product Owner for Structures, co-leading the 9-engineer structures subteam for the 2026-27 airframe.

STATUS: ‘25-‘26 season: 5th overall at SAE Aero East. ‘26-‘27 season in progress as Product Owner, Structures.

item.title: PBA (Custom BJT 3D Printer)
item.description:
A PhD student handed me four steel brackets epoxied together and asked me to make a plate go up and down. The actual goal: a binder-jet 3D printer that survives an autoclave.

STATUS: Shelved August 2025. Between a ridiculous amount of feature creep, and SAE Aero kicking off, I ran out of time.

item.title: LF3DP
item.description:
A large format pellet-extrusion 3D printer built at the RPS, based on Dr. D. Flo’s open-source LF3DP design. I owned the gantry build through early 2025, then handed it off.

STATUS: Partial assembly. X-axis carriage built, waiting on machinist to trim the C-channel extrusion and install electronics. Will not finish before I graduate.
